product_metadata.title: Lulu Home 2 FT Pre-lit Artificial Mini Christmas Tree, 24 Inch Tabletop Battery Operated Pine Tree with 50 LED Lights and Burlap Wrap Base for Christmas, Spring Decor
features: NATURAL LIFE LOOK: Lulu Home artificial table top pine tree is 2ft in height based with a 2"H x 4"D concrete pier covered with burlap cloth. The tree gives a full and fluffy look from any angles in your decorated places. The lush artificial tree presents in a color in natural new green, brings great vigor and vitality.

50 LED WITH 8 LIGHTING MODES: Lulu Home small artificial Christmas tree comes with warm white 50 LED pre-strung string lights with timer (automatically 6 hours ON/ 18 hours OFF) which lighting in 8 modes: COMBINATION, IN WAVES, SEQUENTIAL, SLOGS, CHASING/FLASH, SLOW FADE, TWINKLE/FLASH and STEADY ON. Just light up the tree with any mode you like to create great festival holiday joy atmosphere.

BATTERY OPERATED & PORTABLE: Lulu Home pre-lit mini Christmas tree is powered by 3 AA batteries (NOT INCLUDED), allowing to be carried and placed indoors or outdoors without limit of power supply socket. Great Ideal for dining table, bedside table, desk and balcony decoration.

STAND STEADILY & LASTING LONG: All branches and tips are made of high-quality PVC, which makes it lasting and durable. The 2"H x 4"D concrete pier covered with burlap cloth is not weighted too much but helps the tree to keep in good balance while sitting on the ground or any other flat surface.

WONDERFUL SPRING DECORATION: Standing 2 ft in height, Lulu Home artificial pre-lit pine tree takes 5 minutes at most for fluffing and fully shaping. You can also add other holiday decorations to create great festival holiday atmosphere you like to celebrate the spring and welcome the new year.
